---
title: "Third-level education"
description: "How many students are in universities and colleges, and how Ireland compares with the rest of the EU."
---

Third-level education covers universities, technological universities and other higher education colleges. Most students start after finishing secondary school.

There were 283,950 students enrolled in third-level education in 2025-2026, about a third more than in 2014-2015.

{{< chart education-third-level-students >}}

In 2025, 69% of people aged 30 to 34 in Ireland had a third-level qualification, the highest share of any EU country, just ahead of Luxembourg at 68%. The average across the 27 EU countries was 46%.
